evidence: The films deposited at low temperature (100–150 °C) are amorphous and exhibit a relatively high refractive index. The observation from the SEM results also suggests a compact structure of these films, which rationalizes their high refractive indices. The grain sizes observed from the FESEM images of the films deposited at high temperature are about 50 nm, which are significantly larger than the crystallite sizes deduced from the XRD results.
